content.title: About
content.content: Plain rice crispy cereal is a dry grain product made from whole rice that is toasted to a crisp texture. It contains no added sugar, flavorings, or colorings, making it a neutral base for breakfasts and snacks.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The flakes are produced from whole rice that is first cooked and then rapidly toasted in hot air.
Rice crisps are often used in gluten‑free diets because rice naturally lacks gluten.
Compared with corn flakes, rice crisps have a milder taste and absorb milk or yogurt more readily.
In the United States they are known as “Rice Krispies” and are a popular ingredient for desserts such as Rice Krispie Treats.
The flakes retain many B‑vitamins that are present in whole rice.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Rice crisps contain virtually no fat, making them suitable for low‑calorie diets.

items.title: Source of complex carbohydrates
items.content: The carbs are released slowly, providing sustained energy and a feeling of fullness.

items.title: Gluten‑free
items.content: Safe for people with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

items.title: Rich in B‑vitamins
items.content: Vitamins B1, B3 and B6 support energy metabolism and nervous system function.

items.title: Easy to digest
items.content: Low fiber content makes them gentle on the stomach, useful during digestive upset.

items.title: Low protein and fiber
items.content: Rice crisps alone do not provide sufficient protein or dietary fiber, so they should be combined with other foods.

items.title: High glycemic index
items.content: They can raise blood sugar quickly, which may be undesirable for people with diabetes.

items.title: Rice allergy
items.content: Rarely, some individuals may experience an allergic reaction to rice.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Pour milk, yogurt, or a plant‑based drink over the flakes and add fresh berries, nuts, or dried fruit. They are also used in dessert recipes, snack bars, and as a crunchy coating.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep in a sealed container in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. For extended storage, refrigerate to prevent moisture absorption.
